acceptance: Build artifacts are untracked or generated outside the source tree
The tracked build configuration matches what the compile path uses, and a test or guard keeps them in sync
description: _sources/tpc-h/dbgen/ tracks stale Windows .o files and a Makefile.auto that no longer matches what benchbox/utils/tpc_compilation.py generates. The runtime auto-compile fallback rewrites both in place, so running it dirties the working tree and can mask which build configuration produced a binary.
